description: Gap-robust version of the subsite control and the figure: subsite conservation against overall identity for 68 reviewed GalE-type epimerases, with bll6421 placed on the trend
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
df=pd.read_csv("struct_subsite_control_panel.csv")
df["n_aligned"]=df.pattern.fillna("").apply(lambda s: sum(1 for c in s if c!="-"))
df["frac_aligned_ident"]=df.subsite_ident/df.n_aligned.replace(0,np.nan)
df.to_csv("struct_subsite_control_panel.csv",index=False)
Q=df[df.acc=="Q89GC4"].iloc[0]
epi=df[(df.group=="epimerase")&(df.panel.str.startswith("GalE"))]
band=epi[(epi.overall_pid>=20)&(epi.overall_pid<=35)]
print("gap-robust metric (identity among contact positions that align without a gap):")
print(f"  bll6421: {Q.subsite_ident}/{Q.n_aligned} = {100*Q.frac_aligned_ident:.1f}%")
print(f"  matched band (n={len(band)}): median {100*band.frac_aligned_ident.median():.1f}%, "
      f"range {100*band.frac_aligned_ident.min():.1f}-{100*band.frac_aligned_ident.max():.1f}%")
print(f"  band members at or below bll6421: {int((band.frac_aligned_ident<=Q.frac_aligned_ident).sum())}/{len(band)}")
print(f"  full GalE panel (n={len(epi)}): median {100*epi.frac_aligned_ident.median():.1f}%")
# non-epimerase panels for context
oth=df[(df.acc!="Q89GC4")&(~df.panel.fillna('').str.startswith("GalE"))]
print(f"  all non-GalE reviewed members (n={len(oth)}): median {100*oth.frac_aligned_ident.median():.1f}%, "
      f"fraction at or below bll6421: {100*(oth.frac_aligned_ident<=Q.frac_aligned_ident).mean():.1f}%")
sl,ic,r,pp,se=stats.linregress(epi.overall_pid,epi.subsite_ident)
resid=epi.subsite_ident-(sl*epi.overall_pid+ic); pred=sl*Q.overall_pid+ic

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5.4))
ax[0].scatter(epi.overall_pid,epi.subsite_ident,s=26,c="#2f855a",alpha=.75,label="reviewed GalE-type 4-epimerases (n=68)")
xs=np.linspace(18,100,50); ax[0].plot(xs,sl*xs+ic,"k-",lw=1.3,label=f"fit: slope {sl:.2f}/%id, r={r:.2f}")
ax[0].fill_between(xs,sl*xs+ic-resid.std(),sl*xs+ic+resid.std(),color="k",alpha=.10)
oth2=df[(df.acc!="Q89GC4")&(~df.panel.fillna('').str.startswith("GalE"))]
ax[0].scatter(oth2.overall_pid,oth2.subsite_ident,s=12,c="#a0aec0",alpha=.5,label="other reviewed subfamilies (n=283)")
ax[0].scatter([Q.overall_pid],[Q.subsite_ident],s=190,marker="*",c="#c53030",zorder=5,label="bll6421 (Q89GC4)")
ax[0].annotate(f"observed 3/23\npredicted {pred:.1f}/23\nresidual {(Q.subsite_ident-pred)/resid.std():+.2f} SD",
               (Q.overall_pid,Q.subsite_ident),xytext=(34,1.2),fontsize=9,color="#c53030",
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#c53030"))
ax[0].set_xlabel("overall identity to E. coli GalE (%)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("identical residues at the 23 UDP-glucose contact positions")
ax[0].set_title("Divergence-matched control: subsite conservation tracks overall identity,\nand bll6421 falls below the trend",fontsize=10)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper left")
bp=ax[1].boxplot([band.subsite_ident.values,
                  df[(df.panel.fillna('').str.startswith("HldD"))].subsite_ident.values,
                  df[(df.panel.fillna('').str.startswith("RmlB"))|(df.panel.fillna('').str.startswith("Gmd"))].subsite_ident.values,
                  df[(df.panel.fillna('').str.startswith("3beta"))|(df.panel.fillna('').str.startswith("DFR"))|(df.panel.fillna('').str.startswith("CCR"))].subsite_ident.values],
                 labels=[f"GalE-type\n20-35% id\n(n={len(band)})",f"HldD\n(n=158)","RmlB+Gmd\n(n=47)","nucleotide-\nindependent\n(n=46)"],
                 widths=.55,patch_artist=True)
for b,c in zip(bp["boxes"],["#2f855a","#4299e1","#ed8936","#a0aec0"]): b.set_facecolor(c); b.set_alpha(.7)
ax[1].axhline(Q.subsite_ident,color="#c53030",lw=2,ls="--")
ax[1].text(4.45,Q.subsite_ident+0.25,"bll6421 = 3/23",color="#c53030",fontsize=10,ha="right")
ax[1].set_ylabel("identical residues at the 23 UDP-glucose contact positions")
ax[1].set_title("bll6421 sits below every divergence-matched 4-epimerase\nand below the median of every other subfamily",fontsize=10)
plt.suptitle("The UDP-sugar subsite loss in bll6421 is not explained by divergence alone",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
